At BAT we are proud of the progress we are making on the
journey to transform our business.
We are committed to achieving our goal of £5 billion revenue
from our new categories by 2025. As we are to tracking and
sharing our progress.
We continue to focus on delivering strong returns for our
shareholders, ensuring a progressive environment for our
more than 50,000 global employees and addressing our
impact on society as a whole.
These ambitions inspire us to keep accelerating towards
building A Better Tomorrow™.
*BAT Group
